en.html:
I stop short of saying it outright. But the chief cannot have missed my meaning.

In one aspect, Silver Star is the highest peak of modern armed force. Then on what basis do we declare that the League Army has no military curiosity about it, or that it has not already made <ruby>contact<rt>・・</rt></ruby>?

The chief and I discussed exactly this yesterday. Silver Star must have a <ruby>patron<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>.

　あるいは、既に<ruby>接触<rt>・・</rt></ruby>を果たしていないと、どうして

　署長とは昨日も話し合ったのだ。

en.html:
Chief"But that risk you have already taken, no? In the recent incident you fought alongside her."
Kageaki"I judged it necessary. On that occasion I first tried Silver Star's name on her, as one tries a test reagent."
Kageaki"No special reaction. Very nearly complete indifference, in fact. But that may only mean nobody has told her anything."
Chief"..."
Kageaki"If we now carry out investigations together, there is even the possibility that everything goes straight through her to the mastermind."

景明 「必要と判断しましたので。 　あの折はまず、試薬のつもりで銀星号の名 を出してみました」
景明 「特別な反応はなし。ほぼ無関心に近いほど でした。 　しかしそれは、単に彼女が何も知らされて いないだけかもしれません」

景明 「今後、捜査活動を共にするとなれば…… 　彼女を通して情報が全て黒幕に筒抜け、と いう可能性さえ」

Kageaki"—Personally, I do not mind even so. If it comes to that, some reaction is certain. Let that dark arm reach out. We shall take hold of it and turn its reach against it."
Chief"If you have that resolve, I have nothing more to say. I leave everything to you."
Kageaki"Chief. ...Are you sure about this?"
Chief"My mind was made up long ago. It is the one thing I am able to do. As far as the Silver Star matter goes, use me however you like."
Chief"Understood?"
Kageaki"..."
Kageaki"Ji."
